body: <sf-progress-ring id="r2" label="Использовано 85 % лимита" value="85" status="warning" meter><sf-avatar slot="content" size="1/2" text="АК" aria-label="Анна Ким"></sf-avatar></sf-progress-ring>

checks.title: the ring is a progressbar named by label, its valuenow the value; the percentage is shown and hidden from the reader

steps.check: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#r1 .sf-progress-ring-indicator'); const c = document.querySelector('#r1 .sf-progress-ring-content'); return r.getAttribute('role') === 'progressbar' && r.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Загрузка файлов' && r.getAttribute('aria-valuenow') === '62' && r.getAttribute('aria-valuemin') === '0' && r.getAttribute('aria-valuemax') === '100' && !r.hasAttribute('tabindex') && c.textContent.trim() === '62%' && c.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true'; })()

checks.title: meter: role meter; the avatar stands beside the ring, fitted to the content box, 2 px from the line

steps.check: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('#r2 .sf-progress-ring'); const ring = document.querySelector('#r2 .sf-progress-ring-indicator'); const avatar = document.querySelector('#r2 .sf-progress-ring-content .sf-avatar'); if (!avatar) return false; const a = root.getBoundingClientRect(); const b = avatar.getBoundingClientRect(); const line = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--sf-progress-ring--line-width')); const gap = Math.round(b.left - a.left - line); return ring.getAttribute('role') === 'meter' && ring.getAttribute('aria-valuenow') === '85' && !ring.contains(avatar) && Math.abs(b.width - (a.width - 2 * (line + 2))) < 0.5 && gap === 2 && root.classList.contains('sf-progress-ring--warning'); })()

checks.title: indeterminate: no valuenow, the turning arc

steps.check: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#r3 .sf-progress-ring-indicator'); return r.getAttribute('role') === 'progressbar' && !r.hasAttribute('aria-valuenow') && document.querySelector('#r3 .sf-progress-ring').classList.contains('sf-progress-ring--indeterminate'); })()

checks.title: without label the host's aria-label names the ring; size 2 is the control height of 2

steps.check: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('#r4 .sf-progress-ring'); const probe = document.createElement('div'); probe.style.width = 'var(--sf-ui-2--control-height)'; document.body.append(probe); const want = probe.getBoundingClientRect().width; probe.remove(); return document.querySelector('#r4 .sf-progress-ring-indicator').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Копирование' && root.getBoundingClientRect().width === want && root.getBoundingClientRect().height === want; })()

checks.title: value is a number, clamped to 0..100
chunk {done, total} shows a part of a job in per cent
a page's fill colour wins over the status; a bare 0 for the line and the gap is a valid length

steps.check: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('#r-var .sf-progress-ring'); const s = getComputedStyle(root); return s.getPropertyValue('--sf-progress-ring--fill').trim() === 'rgb(1, 2, 3)' && s.getPropertyValue('--sf-progress-ring--line-width').trim() === '0px' && s.getPropertyValue('--sf-progress-ring--gap').trim() === '0px'; })()
